headline: Baker Mayfield (QB-TB) questionable with foot strain
body: Mayfield missed three games earlier in the season due to a dislocated right thumb, and he injured his foot during the Buccaneers' Week 9 loss to the Bears. He was in a walking boot during Tampa Bay's bye and received treatment on his foot during Week 11 prep, although head coach Todd Bowles told reporters Friday that Mayfield is "trending in the right direction" to play against Detroit. As it stands, Mayfield will be under center for the Buccaneers on Sunday, with undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels serving as the backup and Easton Stick operating as the emergency third quarterback.

headline: Sione Vaki (RB-DET) questionable with ankle injury
body: If Vaki is unable to play against Tampa Bay, Jacob Saylors would move up to RB2 status, but Jahmyr Gibbs would have a chance to see an even bigger share of the backfield opportunities in that scenario.

headline: Roman Wilson (WR-PIT) placed on IR with hand injury
body: Both Wilson and Michael Pittman (foot) are listed as questionable but remain on injured reserve. The duo could be activated Saturday if cleared to play against Philly. Wilson has been sidelined since injuring his finger in Week 5 against the Colts.

headline: Michael Pittman Jr. (WR-PIT) placed on IR with foot plantar fasciitis
body: Pittman was designated for return from injured reserve earlier this week and had progressed to full participation Thursday, so his questionable tag keeps him in the mix for a potential activation ahead of Sunday's contest against the Eagles. With both Pittman and Roman Wilson (finger) nearing a return, it's unclear what that will mean for rookie Germie Bernard's role going forward, as the rookie has hit a slow spot in the box score the last couple weeks.

headline: Puka Nacua (WR-LAR) placed on IR with MCL sprain
body: Given that timetable, Nacua -- who already is on injured reserve -- could be out for the rest of the regular season, which is a huge blow to the Rams' pass-catching corps going forward. In Nacua's continued absence, Konata Mumpfield, CJ Daniels, Tutu Atwell and Xavier Smith are the team's healthy options at WR, though fellow starter Davante Adams (hamstring) is believed to be targeting a return in Week 12 following the team's bye.

headline: Mike Evans (WR-SF) questionable with achilles tendinitis
body: Evans got back on the practice field Thursday as a limited participant, marking his first on-field work since aggravating his right Achilles during a Week 6 win versus the Commanders. Shanahan indicated that the team wants to see how Evans reacts to this week's practices before making a call on his availability for Sunday's showdown. In the end, though, San Francisco may not make an official ruling on Evans' status until about 90 minutes before an 8:20 p.m. ET kickoff.

headline: Matt Gay (K-LV) questionable with hip injury
body: Gay, who was limited Wednesday, logged a DNP on Thursday, but it looks like he'll work in some capacity to close out the week. Per Warren, the Raiders worked out three kickers with Gay injured, but it appears as though it's only Gay and practice-squad member Kansei Matsuzawa available to handle kicks at Friday's practice.

headline: Jonathon Brooks (RB-CAR) placed on IR after groin surgery
body: Brooks remains on injured reserve, so the questionable tag suggests Carolina at least may activate him ahead of Sunday's contest. If he's cleared to play, the running back would be in line to make his first appearance since Week 2, though he's no real threat to Chuba Hubbard's standing as the Panthers' lead back.
